To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
1) policy based models are a useful tool to manage resources in distributed environments, 2) the use of policies can be extended to the memory management of distributed shared memory systems.
policy-based memory management models are useful to manage memory resources in clusters of workstations.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a memory management system, which provides a set of memory management policies and allows the selection of these policies to be controlled by policies.

the development of a memory management system for clusters of workstations that supports multiple applications, and that is flexible enough to adapt the behavior to the requirements of the running application.
the design of policy based management systems that allow applications and system administrators to control the behavior of the system at runtime.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the policy-based management model provides an effective mechanism to manage the dynamic and changing requirements of distributed applications.
this paper proposes a policy-based model for resource management in distributed systems.
the proposed policy model provides a simple and effective way to manage resources in multi-application clusters.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are able to provide applications with a policy enhanced interface, that allows applications to dynamically adapt to changing conditions in a cluster, and thus improve their performance.
we are developing a policy-based memory management model for a distributed shared memory system.
the policy-based management model provides the ability to dynamically change the behavior of the system, while maintaining a consistent view of the system to applications.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the use of policies provides a flexible framework for the development of distributed shared memory systems that support different memory placement and memory consistency policies, and allows for the adaptation of the memory management model at runtime.
policy-based systems provide a simple yet powerful way to adapt system behavior at runtime.
the proposed model is generic and can be used to provide a framework to manage resources in a multi-application environment.
